lineage: IV. Protista & Monera -> Slime Molds & Bacteria -> Coprinopsis

scale.note: The exact SI length is 7.744e-05 m. The loop brief labels it 77 µm. log10(7.744e-05) = -4.111.

evolutionary_history.scale_contrast: No named predecessor or successor chronospecies. Relative to the 10 µm tier floor, this detail variant is 7.744× longer. With Schnakenberg kinetics held fixed, k_c ∝ (D_u D_v)^{-1/4} ∝ γ^{1/2}, so selecting 10 µm instead of 77.44 µm requires γ larger by 7.744² ≈ 59.97 or a diffusion product smaller by 7.744⁴ ≈ 3596. The Holocene age lock is 0 Ma: the extant gray-shag pileus is the terminus of this chronoseries.

equations.kinetics: f = a - u + u^2 v,  g = b - u^2 v
equations.pde: du/dt = γ f + D_u ∇²u,  dv/dt = γ g + D_v ∇²v
equations.turing_trace: D_v f_u + D_u g_v > 0 and (D_v f_u + D_u g_v)^2 > 4 D_u D_v det(J)

parameters.gamma_note: γ is solved so λ_c = 7.744e-05 m at (Du, Dv) = (1, 16). It is not a free copied constant.

empirical_claims: Turing (1952) selects a finite critical wavenumber when the inhibitor diffuses sufficiently faster than the activator.
Schnakenberg (1979) supplies the two-species kinetics used here; the steady state and Jacobian are exactly those of f = a - u + u^2 v, g = b - u^2 v.
Kües (2000) reviews fruiting-body development in Coprinus cinereus (the name then used for Coprinopsis cinerea), including gill formation.
Stajich et al. (2010) assemble the Coprinopsis cinerea chromosomes and treat the species as a model multicellular mushroom.
The 77 µm length is the MorphoEval assigned characteristic scale for this slot (tier-4 detail variant). It is not a spacing measured on the vendored photograph, which has no scale bar.
The photograph shows a mature lamellate cap. Gill spacing on that fruiting body is a millimetre-scale readout, not the 77 µm cellular wavelength simulated on the 8-wavelength cuticle patch.
